items.title: StyleSmuggler: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE) Zero-Day
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source installations. It has a CVSS score of 10.0 and is actively being exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including Stored XSS (CVE-2026-76200, CVE-2026-76201) and Incorrect Authorization (CVE-2026-77109). Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability leading to Customer Account Takeover
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability with a CVSS score of 9.1 allows an attacker to gain elevated access to sensitive resources without user interaction. This flaw has been added to the CISA KEV catalog and is being exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This security update addresses seven vulnerabilities, including an unauthenticated customer account takeover (CVE-2026-71362). Successful exploitation could result in security feature bypass, arbitrary code execution, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical and important vulnerabilities that could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system read, and application denial-of-service. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for these issues.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Unauthenticated File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, opening the door to remote code execution.

items.title: Critical vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento
items.summary: Sansec discovered an unauthenticated PHP object injection flaw in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a popular Magento full-page cache extension. This critical vulnerability could lead to severe compromise.
